== Published English Original Virtual Set 8 wording ==
The known earlier full card moves the Effect to table, narrows the all-ability test to aliens, and makes the ability increase or damage protection a choice. The 17 September 2007 slip restores site placement and opposing control cancellation, specifies the exterior Tatooine battleground and keeps only an ability modifier for site battle. The historical V17 alternate says may add. The official slip and current full reconstruction print is +X.
